fightLines.line: You wake up with dirt in your mouth and blood on your hands that isn't yours. The sky is the wrong color — not sunset-wrong, wound-wrong. Consuelo Stein. Pottery instructor. From Columbus, Ohio. That was yesterday. This is now. You have: Dispatcher's headset, Brass Locket, Seed packet, Notebook, Hoodie. That's everything you own in this world. Haven. Twelve people. The fire is lit. They found a deer this morning. Inside out. Not eaten — unmade. Like something was trying to understand how it worked. It didn't finish.
🎒 A man, maybe 30s shoulders a pack. "Going far this time. Don't wait up."
You remember the Stone knife at your space in the haven and fetch it — it rides in your pack now.
Hunger gnaws. The pack is thin — work the green, haul it back, get it named at camp. That's the whole game.
📺 Theo killed stripes resolving out of the bamboo, watching you out past the ridge — alone — and walked home. 7 rounds, 70 taken. (The village watches the broadcast. Nobody blinks.)

Awudu leans in, voice low. "Here's what we figured out about a dog-shaped silence at the treeline. Wound the lead. Wound the lead and the pack breaks. Hit the FIRST wolf — the one that came in first — and the coordination dies. They fear fire, but breaking the lead is free."

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — a dog-shaped silence at the treeline: Wound the lead. Wound the lead and the pack breaks. Hit the FIRST wolf — the one that came in first — and the coordination dies. They fear fire, but breaking the lead is free. (Someone at the haven knew the trick.)
📓 Journal: Counter: Wound the lead — Wound the lead and the pack breaks. Hit the FIRST wolf — the one that came in first — and the coordination dies. They fear fire, but breaking the lead is free.
⚔️ Milton killed the dog-shaped silence at the treeline with their party — 3 rounds, 64 taken. Word travels fast. The village cheers.

🔥 The fire settles. Milton has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Hushpuppy — I put it down today." "No telegraph you can hear. Watch the birds — when they go quiet, the pack is already moving." "The pack circles — nips from the edge, never committing." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Vidar asks "Did it look at you? Before?" Fatima asks "We've been walking past those." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"
Hunger gnaws. The pack is thin — work the green, haul it back, get it named at camp. That's the whole game.

◈ RESONANCE HARMONICS — SYSTEM: "HYPOTHESIS CONFIRMED. Objects with high observer-attention waveforms function as auxiliary capacitors. We call this RESONANCE HARMONICS. We do not know why the waveforms taste like grief. We have stopped asking." — Hold a keepsake. Think about them. The System will do the math. (It is not math. It is love. The System will never know.) Channel keepsakes from your pack.
🐺 HOWLS in the distance. Closer than before. The System chirps: "Oh! We made those! Are they... too many? We can make fewer?" (New monster: hushwolf pack.)
◈ "UNIT SEED PACKET — [TRANSLATION COMPLETE] — we have been watching you carry this. Attachment waveform: significant. Function decoded: +resolve when worn. You knew it mattered before we did. Cute."

◈ FLASHBACK — Seed packet
Pressed into your hand with an order: keep people fed through winter. Seeds are a plan. Plans are how you stop being helpless.
